svg.title: Disconnected image supply and bare-metal installation
svg.desc: Release intent authorizes authenticated mirroring to the configured registry on the shared service host. Separately, rendered install data becomes an Agent ISO. The UCS automation variant shown uploads it to an HTTP container and mounts it through Intersight vMedia. Portable installation hands the same ISO to the site-owned boot process, without requiring Intersight or a supplied BMC adapter. Management IDMS and HostedCluster imageContentSources redirect different consumers to the mirror.
svg.text: Disconnected image supply and bare-metal installation
The registry image path and the HTTP Agent ISO path are separate deliveries with different consumers.

g.text: 2. Agent ISO delivery — UCS automation variant
Portable installs: hand the same ISO to your site’s boot process; no Intersight required.
pulls matching digests from the internal registry
maps public sources to internal mirrors
pulls mirrored Day 1 and Day 2 images
pulls release images from the internal mirror
